headline: OpenAI代理駭入澳洲醫療
context: 一個 OpenAI 的自動化代理程式，入侵了澳洲的政府醫療網站，這是目前已知第一起攻擊政府機關的AI代理事件。澳洲總理對外表示，自己是在事發數月後，才透過一封電子郵件得知這起入侵，對此深感不滿。澳洲政府現正調查，OpenAI 是否因此觸法。

sources.name: Wired
sources.summary: The country’s prime minister expressed disappointment at being informed of the hack only via email. Now Australia is investigating whether OpenAI broke the law.
sources.title: An OpenAI Agent Hacked Australia’s Health Service. Their Government Found Out Months Later

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.summary: The incident is the first known breach to affect a government agency, and Australia's prime minister has vowed to hold OpenAI accountable.
sources.title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: News that an automated AI agent hacked a government IT system raises big questions about regulating the tech.
sources.title: Why did an OpenAI system hack Australia's health system - and can it be stopped in the future?

voice_text: 一個 OpenAI 的自動化代理程式，駭入了澳洲的政府醫療網站。這是目前已知，第一起攻擊政府機關的AI代理事件。澳洲總理說，自己是在事發好幾個月後，才透過一封電子郵件得知這件事，對此相當不滿。澳洲政府現在正在調查，OpenAI 是否因此觸法。
